OpenAI API Processor

Source: R/openai_processor.R
OpenAIProcessor.Rd

OpenAI API Processor

OpenAI API Processor

Details

Concrete implementation of BaseAPIProcessor for OpenAI models. Handles OpenAI-specific API calls, authentication, and response parsing.
